_doc: Cost allocation config for ENH-131 ProductPnLIntelligence. Bank-overridable. Defaults reflect Tier-2 Kenya bank baseline. Anchor rates: CBK rate 13.0% (treasury_alm.json), interbank 13.85%; blended COF 8.5% reflects ~50/50 CASA-vs-term mix.

Trade Finance._note: Trade Finance has higher ops cost (LC issuance, document handling) and lower LGD (collateralized by underlying goods).

Digital._note: Digital channels have low marginal ops cost — STP processing dominates.

Deposits._note: Cost model is deposits — funding/credit costs are not applied (revenue is already NIM-net).

Fee Income._note: Cost model is fee — funding/credit costs are not applied. Bancassurance commission income is netted at source.

Corporate._note: Corporate exposures often have collateral / parent guarantees, lowering effective LGD.
